_about.what: Per trade week of Ofgem's weekly forward (the dated series in ofgem_forward_weekly_with_delivery_start_2021_2026.json), what a supplier serving domestic demand would have paid per MWh had it bought a flat volume equal to mean demand at that week's forward for its 12-month delivery year, against floating at spot. Plus one row per delivery start for a cap-style ladder: the mean forward over every assigned trade week for that delivery start.
_about.definitions: hedged = forward + (realised_demand_weighted - realised_time_weighted); floating = realised_demand_weighted; hedge_gain_vs_floating = realised_time_weighted - forward (the demand shape does not enter it). Method, sources and caveats: what_a_baseload_hedge_at_the_published_forward_leaves_open_for_domestic_demand_2026-11-14.md
_about.electricity_spot: Elexon SSP per half hour (imbalance price, not a traded index); PC1 shape factor agrees with MID within 0.006 on 2017-2020
_about.electricity_shape: Profile Class 1 GAD by season and day type (1997 reference year), sim/profile_class_1.py
_about.gas_spot: sim/gas_data/nbp_sap.csv: IMF monthly Europe gas (FRED PNGASEUUSDM) at fixed GBPUSD 1.28, one price per month, NOT NBP SAP; hub of the IMF series not verified here
_about.gas_shape: DESNZ Energy Trends 4.2 domestic monthly shares, 2023-2025 average
_about.coverage: a delivery year is used only where the spot cache covers at least 330 of its days; last delivery start covered: electricity 2025-10-01, gas 2024-07-01
_about.point_in_time: forward_gbp_per_mwh may be read from trade_week_end; every realised_* figure is hindsight over the delivery year and may never be read by a decision dated before that year ends
